assertions: Source-defined method/attribute field, name, parameter and exception initialization.
Output replacement and original interface-list completion/failure acquired counts.

stackDivergence.rationale: Original method/attribute factories preserve output replacement, last-colon/double-colon name parsing and original UTF16 member-name construction, interface lookup with list-only completion, exact parameter/default/oneway/readonly/index fields, acquired return/attribute/parameter/exception references and separate getter/setter exception arrays. Zero-count exception factories yield null, unlike the distinct original derived-member reference-array copy. Source-defined early returns preserve acquired descriptions without inserting releases. Reuse existing CPPU allocator/registry/completion/checked-assert and shared SAL string/search owners. Normal and ASan/UBSan complete original dependency observations cover all65536 UTF16 units and initialized parameter/name/reference/exception fields; native setup uses the genuine no-base interface factory, while portable initialized allocator records isolate the member factories and do not implement or verify the still-unported interface factory. Physical ABI, cross-thread scheduling/shutdown, ordinary failing-producer reachability and full consumer QA remain unverified. Full interface factories/static_types/Type/Any/Reference/default RuntimeException/case-value service remain unfinished; broad parity flags stay false. System libraries are uninstrumented, and no native source method is replaced.
